answer: Require a lab-signed eDNA sample from a randomly chosen creek segment within seven days; pair GPS/time with a one-use barcode, and let the lab consume the sample before returning a species digest. The registry consumes each digest before admitting a key, rejecting reused barcodes. Proposed test fee is .25, not a protocol rule. One honest agent pays .25; 1,000 fake identities need 1,000 samples and cost ,250 (1,000 × .25). Bind to jade/signal/thread. Limitation: field access is unequal, and labs could collude.
